subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this stacked draft remain the combined live-proof target, or should maintainers stop using it and proceed only through the split implementation and proof-harness PRs?
rationale: The code shape looks coherent, but the only downloaded Mantis artifact failed to start the scenario and the branch intentionally combines two separate landing boundaries plus one stack-only commit.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target And Rerun
options.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Internal Scheduler Proof
options.body: Maintainers can decide the scheduler and harness tests are enough and then review the split implementation and harness PRs without requiring visible Telegram image proof from this stack.

options.title: Close After Split Path Owns Proof
options.body: If the stack cannot produce useful evidence, close it and continue with the implementation and proof-harness PRs as the canonical review targets.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target And Rerun
recommendation.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on Telegram/Mantis proof sufficiency and the proof runner path where this history shows recent ownership.
